review_independence_note: Role-separated passes shared one orchestration context and are not claimed as mutually blind or independent review.
external_prior_art: BenchAgent controlled single-agent versus multi-agent workflow comparison

implementation.activation_boundary: No operation can activate a default workflow, modify routing, promote canonical knowledge, or establish intrinsic model-weight improvement.

promotion.operation: non-forced fast-forward of main to exact tested candidate head

saturation.reason: A new capability-shaping coordinate and executable evidence contract were added, but real matched RAKL task ablations have not yet been executed.

next_ai.positive: Build META_N055 with real matched-model RAKL tasks and promote only operators that improve a registered QoI without blocking regressions; use META_N052 as the first similarity/JUMP case study.
next_ai.null: If the smallest targeted compensator or richer scaffold does not beat the simple baseline under matched model/task/resource/evaluator conditions, preserve the null and keep the baseline.
next_ai.refuted: If the capability contract misclassifies resource substitution, blocking regression, or genuine matched improvements, preserve the counterexample and revise the support layer without activating routing.
next_ai.partial_id: If resource and workflow effects cannot be separately identified, report whole-system gain with UNRESOLVED_MIXED_ATTRIBUTION rather than a finer causal claim.
next_ai.blocked: If exact model identity, task packet, evaluator, hidden-label isolation, resource set, or chronology cannot be observed, emit CANNOT_CHECK.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before any future capability-shaping candidate promotion, rebuild against current main and preserve the frozen benchmark and previous result history.
